node.title: Re^4: Parsing HTML/XML with Regular Expressions (XML::Twig)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
In those three examples you linked to, right before you say you do $/='';, which enables "paragraph mode", it's as if the input record separator [doc://$/] was /\n\n+/.

So you are right: I had to pass an handle not an iterator (?) like

is the equivalent of readline(DATA), and since [doc://readline] is being called in list context, it'll read all the records from the handle and return a list of them. So as long as your __DATA__ section doesn't contain any empty lines, it's essentially the same as a slurp - this is probably why the "wrong form" still works.
